policy: Manual assertion review only. References and matching names never establish passing behavior. An empty dimension is unreviewed. Executed outcomes live in the separate source-bound evidence report.

F1.test: language defaults distinguish definition caller and formal environments
F1.checks: Exact JSON distinguishes definition/caller scope, forward defaults, positional/reordered names and interleaved required/optional formals.

F2.test: language explicit arguments override lazy defaults and ignore recursive defaults
F2.checks: Six explicit sources return 42 without demanding recursive or error-valued arguments/defaults.

F3.test: language defaults cache once per call and share dependent parameters
F3.checks: Native counter is two after two demanded calls and remains two after two unused defaults.

F4.test: language invalid binding executes no argument default or body callbacks
F4.checks: Four parse-valid missing/unknown/duplicate-positional-named/extra calls fail at evaluation with no native argument/default/body execution.

F5.test: language statics traverse unused defaults bodies and named arguments
F5.checks: Six invalid unused or overridden defaults/bodies/call sites are rejected during parse, without evaluation.

F6.test: language method defaults retain late self and lexical super
F6.checks: Original/derived method defaults select late self and the method layer's super independently.

O1.test: language object keys exclude new self locals and comprehension self
O1.checks: Six parse-only key-scope rejections plus one exact JSON control separate outer key self from inner value self.

O2.test: language inherited fields separate late self super root and original objects
O2.checks: Exact arrays distinguish final self, super-field self, immutable originals, root $ and nested self.

O3.test: language inherited assertions use final self for access and manifestation
O3.checks: One repaired-base success and four assertion errors on derived/visible/hidden access or manifestation.

O4.test: language manifestation checks assertion only objects recursively
O4.checks: Four recursive assertion-only manifestation errors and exact lazy shape/hidden/ignored-argument controls.

O5.test: language assertions cache checks and do not force messages or failed fields
O5.checks: Repeated fields check once, true assertion message runs zero times, false assertion blocks selected native payload.

O6.test: language visibility inheritance controls JSON output and direct access
O6.checks: All nine separator pairs compare manifested object and direct selected value; hidden overridden function is omitted.

O7.test: language JSON conversion rejects demanded nested functions and errors
O7.checks: Four function manifestations are Type errors, three demanded error expressions are Runtime errors, hidden function body stays uncalled.

S1.test: duplicate formal parameters fail statically before any invocation
S1.checks: Seven duplicate declaration forms, including unused functions, reject at Program creation.

I1.test: imported free variables cannot capture caller locals
I1.checks: Parse resolves nothing; forced imported free x rejects in dependency file after exactly one resolver read.

I2.test: unused imports never resolve even when the target would fail parsing
I2.checks: Six unused local/branch/argument/default/hidden/array imports execute zero resolver calls.

I3.test: import syntax and statics are checked only when the import is forced
I3.checks: Same parsed entry skips invalid dependency then separately observes Syntax/Static errors only after demand, with dependency location and entry context.

IDX.test: P0 indices require integers before conversion for arrays and Unicode strings
IDX.checks: Ten fractional/huge/empty/out-of-bounds errors and integral/Unicode controls, with invalid index preceding lazy payload.

SLICE.test: P0 slicing defers array indexing and keeps strings strict
SLICE.checks: Six expected slice results and three forced-index failures distinguish lazy array slices and strict string slices.

TYPE.test: foundation type returns every documented tag
TYPE.checks: One array compares all seven explicit type tags.

TYPELAZY.test: foundation type and isNumber inspect no nested payload assertion or function
assertions: callback: _ => fail("type reflection called native function")
TYPELAZY.checks: Outer type inspection avoids error payloads/assertions/defaults/body and cannot invoke registered native function.

CRLF.test: text blocks preserve interior and consecutive CRLF blank lines
CRLF.checks: Byte assertions retain interior/consecutive CRLF blank lines; no inference about all string lexing.

CHOMP.test: text-block chomp removes the complete final CRLF
CHOMP.checks: Final CRLF chomp is checked as exact UTF-8 bytes, not a visually equivalent string.

R1.test: recursive local groups bind forward references and mutually recursive functions
R1.checks: forms_value asserts exact JSON through parsed source and exported AST: forward/mutual recursion, shadowing and unused divergent/error bindings.

R2.test: duplicate local groups and sibling scope fail statically before unused execution
R2.checks: Eleven source cases reject at creation: duplicate local groups/functions/object locals/empty comprehension locals, duplicate literal fields, inaccessible sibling/later/outside variables.

R3.test: recursive local aliases share one demanded initializer and skip unused ones
R3.checks: Four alias demands share one native local initializer; the unused local callback is not executed.

R4.test: recursive object local aliases rebind final self and keep lexical super
R4.checks: Parsed source and exported AST distinguish original/derived/original results for forward object-local aliases using final self and lexical super.

C1.test: comprehension domains shadow sequentially and preserve Cartesian order
assertions: local x=['a','b']; {[x]:x for x in x}
C1.checks: forms_value checks exact Cartesian order, enclosing-domain scope and repeated generator shadowing through both entry paths.

C2.test: comprehensions skip excluded domains and keep generated payloads lazy
assertions: if false for y in error 'domain'
C2.checks: Seven exact-value cases via forms_value cover skipped domains, lazy array bodies, selected elements, empty/null keys and an unneeded error-valued iterator.

C3.test: comprehension shape constructs keys before forcing cached selected bodies
C3.checks: Shape constructs two keys; repeated selected field body executes once, other/null-key bodies execute zero times.

C4.test: duplicate and invalid comprehension keys fail before any body callbacks
C4.checks: Both parsed source and exported AST create successfully, then duplicate/nonstring key construction fails as Runtime/Type; counters prove 2/1 key calls and zero bodies.

C5.test: nonboolean comprehension filters reject before later native domains
C5.checks: Array/object invalid filters reject at evaluation through both entry paths, before any later native domain execution.

C6.test: comprehension fields inherit self super locals and root without freezing originals
C6.checks: forms_value checks original/derived comprehension locals using self/super and enclosing-self keys with root $ through parsed source and exported AST.

C7.test: comprehension key and filter errors remain runtime after valid parsing
C7.checks: forms_runtime creates each parsed/AST Program before asserting Runtime/Type and source file; exact key/body error markers distinguish demand sites. Controls skip invalid later numeric domains.

A1.test: handmade AST duplicate local groups reject ordinary and empty comprehension scopes
A1.checks: Four hand-built local/object/empty-comprehension/unused-branch ASTs reject duplicate groups at creation, without parser participation.

A2.test: handmade AST comprehension key and domain scope reject inaccessible bindings
A2.checks: Three hand-built ASTs reject a new object local in key scope and later-loop variables in earlier array/object domains.

A3.test: handmade AST recursive locals and null comprehension keys stay lazy
A3.checks: Hand-built forward local group yields 42; repeated null comprehension keys suppress the error body and yield an empty object.

A4.test: handmade AST dynamic duplicate keys are runtime and literal duplicates static
A4.checks: Hand-built comprehension creates successfully then rejects duplicate runtime keys; literal duplicate object fields reject before Program creation.

AP1.test: handmade calls bind default closures in formal and caller scopes
AP1.checks: A handmade local/function/call tree and its independently written source yield exact values distinguishing closure defaults, supplied positional values and caller-captured named closures.

AP2.test: handmade mutually recursive function defaults capture the same formal environment
AP2.checks: Handmade and source f/g default closures recurse finitely through the call's formal environment, selecting default or supplied x rather than outer x=100.

AP3.test: handmade application rejects invalid bindings before any native demand
AP3.checks: Four handmade ASTs create Programs then reject missing/unknown/overlapping/extra bindings with zero supplied/default/body callbacks; ordinary source variants remain existing controls.

AP4.test: callee errors and nonfunctions precede argument callbacks in source and handmade AST
AP4.checks: Source and handmade calls distinguish numeric/object Type from a demanded callee Runtime marker, require exactly one native head call when present and zero argument calls.

AP5.test: unselected invalid calls skip callee and argument construction demands
AP5.checks: Unused invalid source/handmade calls produce 42 without evaluating either native head or argument.

AP6.test: handmade duplicate names and undefined supplied expressions reject before application
AP6.checks: Callable-target duplicate named arguments and undefined expressions reject Static in unselected source and handmade AST calls before any runtime binding.

AP7.test: malformed call and default expressions reject as source syntax errors
AP7.checks: Three malformed source texts reject Syntax at Program creation; no equivalent malformed-text handmade AST or Static result is claimed.

IR0.test: semantic AST round trip covers expression forms and source identities
IR0.checks: Existing source and exported-AST creation accepts an object containing import, importstr and importbin. Only creation acceptance is reused for the adjacent premise-free judgments; source/copy equality is not a new value oracle or new execution group.

IR1.test: chk importstr accepts opaque canonical strings in source and handmade AST
assertions: assert_true(parsed.ast().kind is ImportFile(p, true) && p == path)
assert_true(synthetic.ast().kind is ImportFile(p, true) && p == path)
IR1.checks: Source and handmade typed leaves accept exact empty, keyword-like, NUL and Unicode/newline string payloads without target data.

IR2.test: chk importstr ignores surrounding static names and object context
IR2.checks: Creation succeeds in shadowed-std/local/function/object/key/unselected source contexts and handmade local/function/object/branch contexts; no resolver is supplied.

IR3.test: importstr static acceptance does not resolve targets or parse opaque data
IR3.checks: Already decoded self-made Source.text data stays opaque: creation resolves none, source/handmade demand returns invalid-code text, unused controls resolve none. This text-resolver case does not test malformed-byte decoding or close loading/cache rules.

IR4.test: importstr does not waive grammar or surrounding static rejection
IR4.checks: Nonliteral/computed source operands reject Syntax; undefined sibling expressions reject Static through source and handmade AST. These are outside-rule boundary controls.

IB1.test: importbin substitutes every unsigned byte in source and handmade AST
IB1.checks: Source and handmade AST independently match exact arrays for all 256 byte values in nonmonotone order, empty/repeated/high-bit/NUL/malformed-UTF8 and code-looking data. Creation makes zero requests; each forced leaf makes one virtual request.

IB2.test: unused importbin source and handmade expressions make zero requests
IB2.checks: Five unused source contexts and handmade local/branch contexts return 42 with zero virtual binary requests; any callback demand would fail. This does not certify every enclosing lazy construct.

IB3.test: importbin separates creation errors from demanded resolver failures
IB3.checks: Three nonliteral source operands fail Syntax, undefined siblings fail Static through source and handmade AST, and successfully created demanded leaves report public Import only during evaluation for disabled/failing virtual resolvers. No CLI exit status is inferred.

IB4.test: handmade repeated importbin demands share one request and exact bytes
IB4.checks: Two handmade imports of the identical request return the same explicit byte arrays with one callback; a second callback would return different data. Alias, cross-mode and failure-cache contracts remain open.

IB5.test: binary import is byte preserving and memoized by canonical identity
IB5.checks: Existing source case observes exact unsigned-byte arrays and one callback for the same path used twice. Despite its historical title, it does not exercise distinct aliases or prove canonical-identity caching. Reused, not a new test group.

IU1.test: importstr decodes explicit UTF8 scalar boundaries in source and handmade AST
IU1.checks: Nine raw-byte/text vectors independently match exact Unicode through source and handmade AST: empty, NUL/CRLF, 1-4 byte scalar boundaries, combining forms, interior U+FEFF, valid U+FFFD and opaque code/escape text. Uses the reusable evaluator binary importer; initial-BOM treatment is excluded and unknown.

IU2.test: importstr rejects malformed UTF8 bytes only on source and handmade demand
assertions: fail("malformed UTF8 became a successful string import")
IU2.checks: Eighteen malformed byte vectors reject after source/handmade creation, including overlong, truncated, bad-continuation, encoded-surrogate and out-of-range cases. Import category/source/context are separately classified host observations; the fixed specification does not prescribe that diagnostic format.

IU3.test: importstr unused invalid data stays lazy and retained bytes still reject
assertions: fail("retained malformed bytes became a successful string")
IU3.checks: Source and handmade unselected branches return 42 with zero requests; two demands per evaluator both reject while one identical request's bytes are retained. This host observation does not complete general failure-cache identity/lifetime rules.

IU4.test: importstr repeated source and handmade requests return exact Unicode text
IU4.checks: Repeated identical source and handmade importstr requests each produce the explicit two-element Unicode/NUL array with one callback. Distinct aliases and cross-mode caches are not exercised.

IF1.test: conditional validates condition then and else scopes even when unused
IF1.checks: Reviewed/pinned conditional_static helper requires Static and the entry identity independently for source parse and handmade AST creation. All three child roles reject alone and in unused wrappers; valid Gamma binds every role. Three malformed source forms separately reject Syntax; no malformed-text AST claim.

IF2.test: conditional preserves object context and isolates sibling local scopes
IF2.checks: Source/handmade sibling-local leaks and self/super in each out-of-object role reject via the reviewed helper. Inherited self/super cases yield 7/9 for true/false, and a condition-local shadow preserves outer x=7 in the chosen branch. These verify conditional context transfer, not full object/binder algebra.

IF3.test: conditional rejects every nonboolean condition before either branch
IF3.checks: All six non-Boolean outer value kinds create Programs through source/handmade AST then reject at runtime with zero branch or nested payload callbacks. Public Type is an embedding category; the normative condition is Boolean-only evaluation.

IF4.test: conditional demands condition then selected branch and preserves failures
assertions: assert_eq( events, if failure == "condition" { ["condition"] } else { ["condition", selected] }, )
IF4.checks: Both source/handmade choices record condition then only the selected child, or only condition when it fails. Exact 7/9 values and Runtime markers separate success and required-child failure. An entirely unused conditional invokes no callbacks. Marker/category checks are host phase controls, not specified diagnostic wording.

IF5.test: conditional transfers all value kinds without manifesting a selected closure
IF5.checks: Both choices and both entry paths retain exact null/Boolean/number/Unicode-string/array/object values, with zero unselected calls. A selected closure is applied afterward, returns 42 and invokes its body exactly once; no eager manifestation or unused-branch demand is accepted.

ES1.test: error delegates operand scope even in unused expressions
ES1.checks: Both independent entry paths reject missing names in demanded, unused-local and unselected-branch errors, and self/super operands outside objects. Valid outer Gamma, numeric operands and self/super object contexts create successfully and yield outer 42. The reviewed helper chooses parse or from_ast without exporting a source AST.

ES2.test: error operand callbacks stay lazy until runtime demand
ES2.checks: Source and handmade Programs create without invoking the operand callback. Unused-local and unselected-branch evaluation returns 42 with zero callbacks; demanded error calls the same string operand once and raises Runtime with its independent marker. These are phase/demand boundaries, not completion of error conversion or diagnostics.

US0.test: AST construction validates names scopes operators and shapes
US0.checks: Reused handmade invalid-operator case rejects Static at AST Program creation with its explicit location. It is a host shape boundary outside the well-formed four-symbol chk-unary domain, not source Syntax or runtime Type evidence.

UP0.test: operator boundaries retain unary suffixes comments and field visibility
UP0.checks: Reused independent finite source result covers prefix minus, logical-not and bitwise-not combinations. Creation/normal controls do not establish complete unary evaluation or every symbol's valid-value semantics.

US1.test: unary delegates unchanged operand scope for all four symbols
US1.checks: All four symbols and both independent entry paths reject missing operands directly and under unused-local/unselected-branch wrappers, plus self/super outside objects. Bound numeric n and own/inherited object contexts accept while unused and yield outer 42; ! over numeric n is statically valid without imposing its later Boolean requirement.

US2.test: unary operand callbacks stay lazy before demanded type rejection
US2.checks: For all four symbols and both entry paths, valid Programs create with zero operand calls. Unused locals and unselected branches return 42 without calls; demanded null operands run once then raise host Type. These are static/runtime demand boundaries, not completion of the unary evaluation rules.

US3.test: unary missing source operands reject syntax before program creation
US3.checks: Four bare legal unary prefixes reject source Syntax before a Program exists. Typed Unary nodes require a child, so no absent-child handmade-AST or Static counterpart is asserted.

FINITE.test: P0 JSON manifestation rejects nonfinite internal values defensively
FINITE.checks: Direct internal +/-Inf/NaN fail both structured and string JSON output paths.
